extracted.intended_audience: general readers interested in Joseph Pulitzer; readers of historical memoirs and early-20th-century journalism
extracted.subtask_description: A first-person recollective memoir describing Alleyne Ireland's experiences as companion-secretary to Joseph Pulitzer, including personal anecdotes, portraits of Pulitzer, and life aboard his yacht and at his villa. The page is the full Project Gutenberg eBook text of that memoir.
